notes.title: February 9th Update
notes.notes:
**I'm sorry for the inconvenience caused to the gameplay.**  

Even if it is not selected normally when selecting a language, the map is automatically moved when the timer of 30 seconds elapses.  

In addition, we have improved the following bugs.  
- Fixed a problem where the button did not work properly on the language selection screen.  
- Fixed an issue where the player's hand was being sponged from behind the right, not in the correct position.  

We will continue to improve to provide a better gaming experience.  
Once again, we ask for your understanding of the inconvenience, and thank you for your valuable feedback.

notes.title: January 26 Update
notes.notes:
This update expands the game's multilingual support. The game now supports the following languages:  
- Korean  
- English  
- Japanese  
- Traditional Chinese  
- Simplified Chinese  
- Spanish  
- French  
- Dutch  
- German  
- Portuguese  
- Italian  
- Polish  
- Russian  

**Additionally, the following bugs have been fixed:**  
1. Fixed an issue where the game would forcefully close when picking up the phone.  
2. Resolved the problem where doors could not be opened with keys.  
3. Fixed an issue where players would spawn in unexpected locations at the start of the game.  
4. Corrected an issue where certain subtitles did not display properly.
